evidence_boundaries.verified_fact: Source, log, data counts, transforms, optimizer order, model shapes, both checkpoint-selection rules, and all fourteen historical checkpoint identities are frozen. A full-route one-member one-epoch H100 run completed and wrote the expected six-key checkpoint.
evidence_boundaries.inference: The retained source is the producer of the fourteen July 15 checkpoint files because filename patterns, timestamps, stored R2 values, optimizer learning rates, model schemas, and the complete adjacent log agree.

evidence_boundaries.metric_boundary: The best_test profile directly selects on the prospective in-house test and is not an independent generalization estimate. The fixed_epoch profile is the default historical screening profile.
evidence_boundaries.paper_scope: This is a post-paper prospective workflow and is not the reported paper three-fold synergy CV.
